# VThree Website Copilot Instructions

- Preserve the existing React/Vite architecture.
- Preserve the approved Production Intelligence Blueprint.
- Preserve approved Delivery narrative and information architecture.
- Do not redesign completed pages or components.
- Reuse established shared components and design tokens.
- Do not introduce dependencies without explicit Founder approval.
- Do not modify unrelated files.
- Maintain responsive behavior and accessibility.
- Run the production build after implementation changes.
- Report any deviation from the approved implementation package.
- Stop before changing routes, global architecture, or approved content.
